regions.interpretation: v2.1: re-checked from raw FR3D lines: 6VUI P1 1-20,2-19,3-18,4-17,5-16 cWW; 7REX 1-22..5-18 cWW in chain A and in crystal copies B,C (1-22 absent in C); no raw FR3D line for 7REX 1-21..5-17. All three RNAs exact-source verified in their genomes; no engineering, no modified nucleotides; 7REX binds two preQ1 (PRF101 contacts 7,8,12,16,30-32) -> plausible cause of L1 differences, not of the P1 register. Shared-correspondence anchor fit (16 anchors, RMSD 2.64 A) and flank-excluded fit (12 anchors, 1.89 A): direction of support unchanged except 6VUI A10 (Rfam-closer -> within 1 A). Exploratory row adjustment (7REX A15-A22 one column left; A15 into insert column 24) preserves nucleotides/order/one-to-one mapping, makes all 5 SS_cons P1 pairs Watson-Crick, preserves 5/7 canonical vs seed 0/7 and loses no seed-preserved interaction (review/candidate_RF00522/). Fresh rerun of STAR3D+FR3D by this agent reproduced the retained mappings/annotations exactly. Canonical-pair evidence is not independent of STAR3D (MC-Annotate WWc preprocessing). || v2.0: Seed's own SS_cons applied to 7REX row gives U1.C21, G2.A20, U3.C19 (non-WC) while 7REX FR3D shows U1-A22..G5-C18 cWW; seed mapping preserves 0/5 6VUI P1 cWW pairs, STAR3D 5/5 (+2 cSW A-minor); neutral C1' fit on 16 agreed residues (RMSD 2.64 A): P1 3' strand STAR3D partners 0.6-3.2 A vs seed 6.1-8.6 A; in L1 (8,10,11) seed partners closer (2.9-3.4 vs 4.3-10 A). Construct native (BLAST 34/34), link verified, nothing masked, replicates/directions identical. Evidence localises to the 7REX row register (one shift); not definitive evolutionary equivalence.
